decision.summary: Objective-based completion with explicit Partial and Insufficient Evidence states.

participation.definition: At least one valid learner contribution was accepted into the canonical interaction. Participation is not evidence, not objective completion, and not mastery.

meaningfulAttempt.definition: A pedagogical evidence definition, not a reward policy.
requiresAll: at least one valid opportunity tied to that objective
at least one assessable learner response to that opportunity
a terminal result that is not invalid
meaningfulAttempt.note: The numeric minimum meaningful call for reward purposes is a separate open decision and is deliberately absent here. A meaningful attempt does not by itself determine any of the five objective result states.

objectiveResultStates.rule: Every required criterion has a valid demonstrated outcome. Optional criteria do not determine objective completion. This is the only state that represents successful objective completion.

Every required criterion has a valid observed outcome; none is invalid, absent, not_observed, insufficient_evidence, or not_demonstrated; at least one is partially_demonstrated; and not all are demonstrated.
At least one required criterion has a valid not_demonstrated outcome. This is a non-punitive, recoverable not-yet-complete result and removes no earned value.
No required criterion is invalid or not_demonstrated, and at least one required criterion is absent, not_observed, or insufficient_evidence. Absence or unusable evidence is not learner failure.
Required evidence or the evaluation context is invalid, malformed, stale, duplicated, or cross-session. This is a system or evaluation result, not learner failure and not negative mastery evidence.

policies.description: The objective is complete only when every criterion listed in requiredCriteria is demonstrated.
Draft placeholder retained so pre-decision contracts remain detectable.

scenarioCompletion.derivedFrom: the explicitly declared required objectives of the scenario; a scenario may be complete only when every declared required objective is complete
scenarioCompletion.legacyRule: The legacy scenariosDone counter remains activity history. It is never read as objective completion and is never backfilled.
scenarioCompletion.aggregateRule: No separate aggregate result property or algorithm exists in v1. Aggregate completion is only the conjunction of the declared required objective results under this same policy.

absenceRule: Absence of evidence is recorded as insufficient_evidence and is never presented as failure, never converted to not_demonstrated, and never treated as negative mastery evidence.

rules: Every state other than complete offers a further-evidence opportunity.
A non-complete state finalizes one attempt but stays eligible for new evidence.
No state removes previously earned XP, coins, streak, rank, evolution, or outfits.
Learner-facing copy is non-punitive and avoids blame.
Remediation is separate from review; review recency remains an open gate.

es.label: Objetivo conseguido
es.explanation: Has mostrado todo lo necesario para este objetivo.

en.label: Objective achieved
en.explanation: You showed everything this objective asks for.

it.label: Obiettivo raggiunto
it.explanation: Hai mostrato tutto ciò che questo obiettivo richiede.

tr.label: Hedefe ulaşıldı
tr.explanation: Bu hedefin istediği her şeyi gösterdin.

ar.label: تم تحقيق الهدف
ar.explanation: أظهرت كل ما يطلبه هذا الهدف.

uk.label: Ціль досягнуто
uk.explanation: Ти показав усе, чого вимагає ця ціль.

es.label: Objetivo a medias
es.explanation: Has conseguido una parte. Todavía falta algo del objetivo; puedes volver a intentarlo cuando quieras.

en.label: Partly there
en.explanation: You got part of the way. Something in the objective is still missing, and you can try it again whenever you want.

it.label: Parzialmente raggiunto
it.explanation: Sei arrivato a metà strada. Manca ancora una parte dell'obiettivo e puoi riprovare quando vuoi.

tr.label: Kısmen tamamlandı
tr.explanation: Bir kısmını başardın. Hedefin bir bölümü hâlâ eksik; istediğin zaman tekrar deneyebilirsin.

ar.label: تحقّق جزئيًا
ar.explanation: أنجزت جزءًا منه. ما زال جزء من الهدف ناقصًا، ويمكنك المحاولة مرة أخرى متى شئت.

uk.label: Частково виконано
uk.explanation: Частину ти зробив. Дещо в цілі ще лишилося, і ти можеш спробувати ще раз, коли захочеш.

es.label: Objetivo no conseguido esta vez
es.explanation: Esta vez no ha salido. Puedes volver a practicarlo; no pierdes nada de lo que ya has ganado.

en.label: Not this time
en.explanation: This time it did not work out. You can practise it again, and nothing you have already earned is lost.

it.label: Non raggiunto questa volta
it.explanation: Questa volta non è andata. Puoi riprovare e non perdi nulla di ciò che hai già ottenuto.

tr.label: Bu seferlik olmadı
tr.explanation: Bu sefer olmadı. Tekrar çalışabilirsin ve şimdiye kadar kazandığın hiçbir şeyi kaybetmezsin.

ar.label: لم يتحقق هذه المرة
ar.explanation: لم ينجح الأمر هذه المرة. يمكنك التدرب عليه مجددًا، ولن تفقد شيئًا مما حصلت عليه.

uk.label: Цього разу не вийшло
uk.explanation: Цього разу не вдалося. Можеш потренуватися ще раз — нічого із заробленого не втрачається.

es.label: Todavía no hay información suficiente
es.explanation: No hemos visto lo suficiente para decirte cómo ha ido. No es un fallo tuyo.

en.label: Not enough to say yet
en.explanation: We did not see enough to tell you how this went. That is not a failure on your side.

it.label: Ancora non abbastanza per dirlo
it.explanation: Non abbiamo visto abbastanza per dirti com'è andata. Non è un tuo errore.

tr.label: Söylemek için henüz yeterli değil
tr.explanation: Nasıl gittiğini söyleyecek kadarını görmedik. Bu senin hatan değil.

ar.label: لا توجد معلومات كافية بعد
ar.explanation: لم نرَ ما يكفي لنخبرك كيف سار الأمر. هذا ليس إخفاقًا منك.

uk.label: Поки що замало даних
uk.explanation: Ми побачили замало, щоб сказати, як усе пройшло. Це не твоя помилка.

es.label: No se ha podido evaluar
es.explanation: Algo ha fallado por nuestra parte y esta práctica no se ha podido evaluar.

en.label: Could not be assessed
en.explanation: Something went wrong on our side, so this practice could not be assessed.

it.label: Non valutabile
it.explanation: Qualcosa non ha funzionato dalla nostra parte, quindi non è stato possibile valutare questa pratica.

tr.label: Değerlendirilemedi
tr.explanation: Bizim tarafımızda bir sorun oldu, bu yüzden bu alıştırma değerlendirilemedi.

ar.label: تعذّر التقييم
ar.explanation: حدث خطأ من جانبنا، لذلك تعذّر تقييم هذا التدريب.

uk.label: Не вдалося оцінити
uk.explanation: Щось пішло не так з нашого боку, тож цю практику не вдалося оцінити.

derivationPrecedence.condition: any required observation is invalid, or the evaluation context is invalid, stale, duplicated, or cross-session
otherwise any required outcome is not_demonstrated
otherwise any required criterion is absent, not_observed, or insufficient_evidence
otherwise every required outcome is demonstrated
otherwise at least one required outcome is partially_demonstrated and every remaining required outcome is demonstrated or partially_demonstrated

derivationRules: The five states are mutually exclusive and exhaustive under this precedence.
Any combination not covered by the precedence is a validation error and is never silently defaulted.
An objective with no required criterion cannot produce a completion result.
Only required criteria participate in the derivation; optional criteria never gate completion.
Accessibility accommodation is not an input and cannot change the derived result.
Missing evidence is never converted into not_demonstrated.
Provider failure, cancellation, inaudibility, offline interruption, or an opportunity never offered cannot create negative learner evidence.
The derivation is provisional and pending learning-specialist review.

separationOfConcerns.evidence: One observation tied to one criterion, attempt, opportunity, response, and curriculum version.
separationOfConcerns.objectiveCompletion: Classifies one objective attempt using only required criterion outcomes.
separationOfConcerns.mastery: A separate longitudinal projection that cannot be assigned directly from one completion result.
separationOfConcerns.placement: Initializes revisable recommendations only and can never mark an objective complete or mastered.
separationOfConcerns.aggregate: Only the conjunction of declared required objective results; never time, hang-up, reward, visit count, scenariosDone, XP, coins, rank, or stage.
